description: A bright yellow crocus flower stands in the center of the composition in what appears to be a gray vase or a bit of paper wrapped around the plant's base. Thin, dark green leaves frame the flower. The minimalist composition contrasts with the plain white surface of the exposed paper surrounding it.
title: Untitled (Yellow Crocus)
